seoTitle: Dexter Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Dexter test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Dexter, Debra, Rita, Batista, Masuka, Doakes, LaGuerta — or Trinity. Get your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the one hiding a secret behind a polite smile, the one who says exactly what they think, or the one who can smell trouble from across the room? Answer 12 everyday questions about how you handle people, pressure and secrets, and find out which Dexter character you are.

characters.name: Dexter Morgan
characters.title: The Man With a Secret
characters.summary: Calm, clever and always watching. You've mastered looking normal, and almost nobody knows the real you.
description: Like Dexter, you're good at your job and easy to have around. He's a blood-spatter analyst for Miami Metro Police, the polite guy who brings doughnuts to the office and never causes a fuss.
But you keep a whole side of yourself hidden. Dexter lives by a strict code taught to him by his adoptive father, Harry, and spends his nights hunting killers who slipped through the system.
You often feel like you're faking the feelings that come naturally to everyone else. The surprise is how much you end up caring anyway: about your sister, about Rita, about your son.
strengths: Protective of the few he loves
characters.flaw: You keep everyone at arm's length, and the secrets keep piling up.
characters.signature: A box of doughnuts, a polite smile and a boat called Slice of Life.
characters.clashReason: they're clearly hiding something, and you can tell

characters.name: Debra Morgan
characters.title: The Foul-Mouthed Fighter
characters.summary: Loud, loyal and brutally honest. You feel everything at full volume, and you'd do anything for your family.
description: Like Debra, you don't have a filter. Deb swears like a sailor, wears her heart on her sleeve and says exactly what she's thinking, usually before she's finished thinking it.
You work harder than anyone because you've always felt you had something to prove. Deb fought her way from Vice to Homicide, and eventually became a lieutenant at Miami Metro.
Your weak spot is loyalty. Deb loved her brother so much that it pushed her into choices that tore her apart.
characters.flaw: Your temper goes off before your brain catches up.
characters.signature: A police badge, a cold beer and at least three swear words per sentence.
characters.clashReason: they'd yell at you, then expect everything to be fine five minutes later

characters.name: Rita Bennett
characters.title: The Gentle Heart
characters.summary: Kind, careful and stronger than people realise. You've been through a lot, and you still believe in people.
description: Like Rita, you're warm and thoughtful: the one who cooks for everyone and makes a house feel like a home. People sometimes mistake your gentleness for weakness.
You've rebuilt your life before. Rita left an abusive marriage and was raising her two children, Astor and Cody, on her own when she met Dexter.
You want a calm, honest, happy life, and you'll forgive a lot to get it. Rita believed in Dexter, and in the man he could be, more than anyone.
strengths: Makes any place feel like home
characters.flaw: You give people too many second chances.
characters.signature: A home-cooked dinner on the table and a warm smile for whoever walks in.
characters.clashReason: they'd want you to open up and talk about your feelings

characters.name: Angel Batista
characters.title: The Good Guy
characters.summary: Warm, romantic and decent to the core. You believe the best about people, and everyone trusts you.
description: Like Angel Batista, you're one of the nice ones. He's a Miami Metro detective with a big smile, a soft heart and a hat for every occasion.
You fall in love easily and you're not ashamed of it. Batista even married his boss, María LaGuerta.
You believe people are mostly good, which makes you easy to fool. Batista worked beside Dexter for years and never found out his secret.
characters.flaw: You trust people who haven't earned it.
characters.signature: A straw fedora and a cheerful "Hey, Dexter!" across the office.
characters.clashReason: they'd always give the benefit of the doubt to people you don't trust

characters.name: Vince Masuka
characters.title: The Lab Joker
characters.summary: Brilliant, cheerful and completely inappropriate. You make every room louder and every day a bit weirder.
description: Like Vince Masuka, you're very good at what you do. He's Miami Metro's lead forensics expert, and he gets genuinely excited about evidence.
You also have no idea when to stop. Masuka's jokes make the whole department cringe, and he's never met a moment too serious for an awkward comment.
Underneath, you're more caring than people think. In the final season Masuka met a daughter he never knew he had, and he tried hard to be part of her life.
characters.flaw: You say what everyone else was thinking, and a few things they definitely weren't.
characters.signature: A lab coat, a pair of gloves and a joke that should have stayed in his head.
characters.clashReason: their jokes would make you want to leave the room

characters.name: James Doakes
characters.title: The One Who Knows
characters.summary: Tough, suspicious and almost always right. You trust your gut, even when nobody else believes you.
description: Like James Doakes, you can smell trouble. He was a Miami Metro sergeant and a former Army Ranger, and from day one he was sure there was something wrong with Dexter.
You don't do small talk or fake smiles. Doakes said what he thought, glared at whoever deserved it and never pretended to like anyone.
Being right doesn't always help. Doakes kept digging while everyone told him to drop it, and he was right about Dexter all along.
characters.flaw: You don't care who likes you, and it costs you allies.
characters.signature: A long, cold stare across the office and one of TV's most famous catchphrases.
characters.clashReason: they'd watch you like you're up to something

characters.name: María LaGuerta
characters.title: The Political Operator
characters.summary: Ambitious, sharp and always a few moves ahead. You know how the game works, and you play to win.
description: Like María LaGuerta, you know exactly where you want to go. She worked her way up to captain at Miami Metro by being smart about who she trusted and when.
You're good at your job, but you never forget the politics. LaGuerta could be charming in a meeting and ruthless the moment it ended.
And you're sharper than people give you credit for. LaGuerta was one of the very few people who worked out Dexter's secret.
characters.flaw: You care a little too much about how things look.
characters.signature: A sharp suit, a perfect smile for the press and a mental list of who owes her.

characters.name: Arthur Mitchell
characters.title: The Perfect Family Man
characters.summary: Everyone thinks you're the nicest person they know, and you work very hard to keep it that way.
description: Like Arthur Mitchell, you seem like the perfect neighbour: a church deacon, a family man, the guy who spends his free time helping build homes for families in need.
But the smile hides something much darker. Arthur was the Trinity Killer, who had been killing across the country for decades without being caught.
You like control, especially at home. Behind closed doors, Arthur's family lived in fear of his temper.
characters.flaw: The face you show the world isn't the real you.
characters.signature: A friendly handshake, a church-going smile and a very dark secret.
characters.clashReason: they'd act like your friend while hiding who they really are

questions.text: You're invited to a work party you'd honestly rather skip. You...

options.text: Make an excuse and stay home. You see them all day anyway
Arrive early, leave last, and make at least one joke you regret
Shake every hand and be the nicest guest in the room
Go. It's a good chance to talk to the right people

questions.text: A colleague presents your work as their own in a meeting. You...

options.text: Make sure the boss knows whose idea it was, politely, in writing
Say nothing. You'll get even when nobody expects it
Tell them to their face, once. They won't do it again
Let it go. You'd rather nobody looked at you too closely

questions.text: A new neighbour is friendly, helpful and always smiling. Something about them feels off. You...

options.text: Trust your gut and keep an eye on them
Give them the benefit of the doubt. Most people are decent
Invite them round for dinner. Maybe they're just lonely
Smile and wave. As long as they leave you alone, it's fine

questions.text: You've got two days off and no plans. How do you spend them?

options.text: Out on a boat, alone, as early as possible
A long lunch with friends that turns into the whole afternoon
Cooking a big dinner for everyone you love
Volunteering. Building something for a family who needs it

questions.text: You find out a close friend has been lying to you about something big. You...

options.text: Explode at them. Then forgive them, because you always do
Tell them you need honesty, and give them one more chance
Smile, say it's fine, and never forget it
Feel annoyed, but not surprised. You'd had a feeling

questions.text: You make a mistake at work that nobody has noticed yet. You...

options.text: Own up. Better they hear it from you
Quietly fix it and make sure there's no trace
Make sure it doesn't land on you
Tell everyone, as a funny story, before anyone else can

questions.text: A friend talks you into trying a new hobby with them. You pick...

options.text: Life drawing. Purely for the art, obviously
Target shooting. You're annoyingly good at it
Cooking. Proper meals, not just takeaway
A tough self-defence class. No small talk required

questions.text: Someone you live with snaps at you after a bad day. You...

options.text: Give them some space, then gently check in
Do what people are supposed to do: make tea and ask if they want to talk
Snap right back. Then hug it out
Stay calm on the outside. Inside, you're furious

questions.text: You're offered a promotion you're not sure you're ready for. You...

options.text: Say yes, then panic about it in private
Take it. You've been working towards this for years
Accept, and promise yourself you'll stay the same person
Turn it down if it means more meetings and less real work

questions.text: If you had a big secret, how well would you keep it?

options.text: Perfectly. Your life would look so normal nobody would ever ask
Easily. Nobody would believe it of someone as nice as you
Badly. You'd have told someone by the end of the week
You couldn't. It'd be written all over your face

questions.text: You're a police officer. You discover that a colleague you like has been secretly killing murderers who walked free. You...

options.text: Arrest them. A killer is a killer
Feel sick, then protect them. You can't lose them
Say nothing yet, and quietly build a case until it's airtight
Refuse to believe it until you see it with your own eyes

questions.text: You're investigating a string of murders. Your main suspect is a friendly church deacon with a lovely family, and your boss tells you to drop it. You...

options.text: Get to know him personally and find out who he really is
Ignore your boss and follow him yourself
Drop it for now. You need proof before you risk your job
Go back over the evidence. The lab doesn't lie
